title: Tampering with Physical Evidence
grade_or_penalty: 4th degree (3rd degree when the related offense is 1st or 2nd degree)
key_points: Altering, destroying, concealing or removing anything, or fabricating false evidence, believing an official proceeding or investigation is pending or about to be.
elements: The suspect believed an official proceeding or investigation was pending or about to be instituted
The suspect altered, destroyed, concealed or removed any article (or made, presented or used false evidence)
With purpose to impair its verity or availability (or to mislead a public servant)
